//: What makes a note a task, read and written by `taskOf`/`withTask` in src/note/task.ts (test/tasks.test.ts), which the server, the page and the CLI all import. One list of cases, so the sidebar, the Tasks page and a card on a board cannot disagree about what a note is.

read.why: a status
a status and a due date
done
case does not matter
a space where the hyphen goes
an underscore where the hyphen goes
to do, spelled as two words
to-do, hyphenated
quoted, and trimmed
a synonym is not a status
a word the three cannot hold is not a status
run together is not a status
an empty status
a boolean is not a status
a number is not a status
a due date alone is not a task
no frontmatter
a status under another key is not the note's
a frontmatter that is not YAML
a frontmatter that is a list
CRLF line ends
among a board's own keys
read.text:
---
theme: neutral
status: done
pages: [a, b]
due: 2026-01-31
---

read.why: a quoted due date
a day that does not exist is no due date
a leap day in a leap year
a leap day in any other year
digits not padded
a time of day is not a date
a year below a hundred is a year
there is no year zero
a due date that is a number
a start date and a due date span the days between
a start date alone
a timed start is no start date
an end is not a task's

write.why: a status added after the title
a status changed where it is
a due date added at the end, after a comment

status: todo
# kept
due: 2026-10-03
---

write.text:

status: todo

---
body

write.why: no longer a task, and the title stays
write.text:

status: done

---
body

write.why: a block left empty goes altogether
a note with no frontmatter grows one, with nothing after it
taking out what is not there changes nothing
a folded value's continuation lines go with it
a blank line at the end of the block stays at the end
a key that only starts with the word is another key
the body is never read for a key

status: done
---
status: todo

write.why: a start date added after the due date
no longer a task takes the start date with it
